title: Community Studies and Outreach Initiatives
description: Internship and/or studies in contemporary urban problems and decision-making processes as they affect the black community. For internships, students are individually assigned, instructed and supervised in fieldwork involving practical experience in decision-making unit of community liaison agencies.
